stem: A child has fever, mouth ulcers and vesicles on the hands and feet. Which pathogen group most commonly causes this illness?
explanation: Hand, foot and mouth disease is most commonly caused by enteroviruses and presents with oral ulcers and vesicles on the hands and feet.
